scope: Descriptive FP64 counterfactual attention on captured dense trajectories only; masks fixed solely from suffix-only prefill pooled scores before opening held-out decode Q. All epsilon/order results retained. No on-policy sparse generation, task-quality guarantee, performance claim, novelty claim, production change, or physical KV capacity release.

numerics.qkv_input_dtype: original captured BF16 converted exactly to FP64
numerics.threshold_reason: Proposal section 5.7 specifies same-mask BF16-versus-FP64 native-calibrated tolerances, not a success threshold for different-support quality. This screen therefore describes errors only.
numerics.epsilon_zero_check: Independent and epsilon-zero output and LSE must be bitwise equal for every request, KV head, budget and anchor.

context_assembly: Keep every system prefix position and complete request-private suffix; common document supports are indexed in original positions. The two protected document-tail positions in the private suffix are included once. Context length must equal captured query_token_position+1. Same-forward group metadata frozen; actual prediction_step may differ by request from group anchor.
metrics: per-request/KV-head flattened-G and each individual query-head relative L2, max absolute error and cosine versus dense and independent
signed change from independent in error against dense
document-conditional dense-softmax mass retained, including private document tail
exact epsilon-zero O/LSE and selected support hashes

compute_allocation.notes: Single-card independent documents; times are accounting only, not a latency benchmark. The reused CPU constructor sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty at import; this wrapper restores run_jobs assigned visibility before any CUDA initialization.
